snippet.title: If Letters Had Pants, Would They Wear Them Like This? - Itch Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Find words in a grid of letters. Get the fanciest (and most combo-friendly) pants for your letters. Unearth objects lost to time. (and their owners) And build the best museum the world has ever seen.

Out now on itch io for Windows, MacOS and Linux!

🔠 Get the game on Itch: https://punkcake.itch.io/if-letters-had-pants
